commercial_product.note: Smith & Nephew is a global medical-technology company organized in three franchises: Orthopaedics (hip and knee replacement implants, trauma and extremities, including the LEGION, JOURNEY II, POLAR3, EVOS, and CORI surgical robotics platforms), Sports Medicine & ENT (arthroscopic enabling technologies, REGENETEN bioinductive implant, and ENT solutions), and Advanced Wound Management (PICO and RENASYS negative-pressure wound therapy, ALLEVYN dressings, ACTICOAT antimicrobial dressings, SANTYL/COLLAGENASE wound debridement). These are approved/marketed devices and are out of scope for an active P1/P2/P3 drug pipeline.

excluded_legacy_terminated: All five Smith & Nephew-related ClinicalTrials.gov records are COMPLETED or TERMINATED Phase 3 device/wound-care studies and are excluded from the active pipeline.
